statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-77696 ("Timing Side-Channel in SM2 Signature Generation", Low): SM2 signature generation computes the signature with variable-time big-number arithmetic on the secret nonce and the private key, so an attacker able to measure SM2 signing times may learn information about the nonce and, over many signatures, recover the private key; applications that generate SM2 signatures are affected on all platforms. OpenSSL 3.5 is affected and fixed in OpenSSL 3.5.9. https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260929.txt, fix on the openssl-3.5 branch https://github.com/openssl/openssl/commit/6b90445a56b99a328ac1feba058abf976504f440, first released in OpenSSL 3.5.9. Debian fixed it for trixie in openssl 3.5.7-1~deb13u3, DSA-6531-1: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-77696. The DHI Debian 13 openssl packages are rebuilds of Debian's trixie openssl, published in the DHI Debian repository and the DHI enterprise repository (the FIPS builds, and the openssl-provider-fips package of every build, only in the enterprise repository); the Debian changelog shipped in each libssl3t64 package shows which Debian release a build is based on. That changelog was read from every published build on amd64 and arm64: 25 versions, 17 standard and 8 FIPS builds, based on Debian 3.5.5-1~deb13u2, 3.5.6-1~deb13u1, 3.5.6-1~deb13u2, 3.5.7-1~deb13u2, 3.5.7-1~deb13u3 and 3.5.9-1~deb13u1. No build based on Debian 3.5.5-1~deb13u2, 3.5.6-1~deb13u1, 3.5.6-1~deb13u2 or 3.5.7-1~deb13u2, FIPS builds included, names CVE-2026-77696. The first published rebuild of Debian 3.5.7-1~deb13u3, the fixed boundary here, and every later build, FIPS builds included, carry Debian's 3.5.7-1~deb13u3 entry naming it. The fix makes sm2_sig_gen() in libcrypto use constant-time Montgomery arithmetic in place of BN_mod_mul(). The disassembly of sm2_sig_gen(), located with the shipped debug symbols from the libssl3t64-dbgsym package of each build, has two calls to BN_mod_mul() and none to EC_GROUP_get_mont_data() or CRYPTO_memcmp() in every build before the first rebuild of Debian 3.5.7-1~deb13u3, and no call to BN_mod_mul() and one call each to EC_GROUP_get_mont_data() and CRYPTO_memcmp() in that build and every later build, FIPS builds included, on both architectures. Of the FIPS providers, the openssl-provider-fips package, read from every build on both architectures, ships the OpenSSL 3.1.2 FIPS provider in the FIPS builds and the FIPS provider from the build's own OpenSSL release (3.5.5, 3.5.6, 3.5.7 or 3.5.9) in the other builds; the advisory states that SM2 is not a FIPS algorithm, and the FIPS builds' libcrypto and libssl are Debian's 3.5 libraries checked above.
